Bello Hardware
Account number: SYN-1011

Dear Customer,

Thank you for contacting us about your January 2026 bill of NGN 6,801,217.20.

We have investigated and found that your meter register rolled over from 99678 to 00111 during the billing period. Your meter has a five-digit display, and when it reached its maximum reading it reset to zero and continued counting. Our billing system did not recognise this rollover and calculated consumption as 99,433 kWh instead of the correct 433 kWh. Your actual consumption of 433 kWh is consistent with your typical monthly usage of between 415 and 441 kWh.

We are crediting your account NGN 6,771,600.00, which is the overcharge of 99,000 kWh at NGN 68.40 per kWh. Your correct charge for January 2026 is NGN 29,617.20. This credit will appear on your next bill and will reduce what you owe.
